title: Invoice Peek
summary: A billing portal lets you see your own invoices. Find out whose else you can reach.
objectives: Sign in with the demo account
Work out how the portal identifies an invoice
Recover the approval code from a confidential invoice
learningOutcomes: Explain why authentication does not imply authorization
Describe a server-side ownership check that fixes the flaw

references.label: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

hints.bodyMd: Look closely at the address bar when you open one of your invoices.
Invoice numbers are sequential, and your own start at 1042. What about lower numbers?
